DCO 2: Range, Waveform, Cross mod, Tune, Fine tune, LFO, Envelope, LFO depth, Env depth, Polarity

notice: Use USB MIDI or a DIN MIDI interface. Match the MIDI channel and enable the required MIDI transmit/receive settings. The linked version 1.00 chart documents modulation, expression, hold and pitch bend but no fixed panel-parameter CC map. Only the ribbons are pre-mapped; use MIDI learn to match later firmware or edited controller settings.  GUI controls generate MIDI into the chain; route that chain to a MIDI output to control the hardware. DIN devices normally appear under the MIDI interface name, so select the profile manually. Unmapped physical buttons and switches have stable SVG IDs for future bindings. Positions are schematic. Note surfaces use virtual defaults; use MIDI learn to match the hardware octave or configuration.
